purpose: Define Sigma_D admissible equivalence criteria using Org_a closure, iff_R preservation, and orientation equivalence.

definition.name: Sigma_D Equivalence Criteria
definition.reading: Sigma_D equivalence represents the statement that G and G' are in the same organizational equivalence class under iff_R and orientation equivalence ≃_O.

equivalence_criteria.Sigma_D_equivalence: Σ_D(G) = Σ_D(G') iff G and G' preserve the same Org_a-closed distinction organization under iff_R and orientation equivalence ≃_O.

formal_candidate.signature_relation: G ~_{Σ_D} G' := Adm_Org(G) ∧ Adm_Org(G') ∧ Inv_D(G)=Inv_D(G') ∧ G iff_R G' ∧ G ≃_O G' ∧ Rec_D(G,G')
formal_candidate.recovery_condition: Rec_D(G,G') := preservation of admissible recovery behavior under registered perturbation classes
formal_candidate.note: Rec_D is a candidate observable bridge to simulation evidence and must remain qualified until perturbation classes are formally registered.

relationship_to_Org_a.statement: Org_a defines admissible organization closure; Sigma_D defines equivalence of such closed organizations.
relationship_to_Org_a.dependency: Σ_D cannot be evaluated on structures that fail Adm_Org.

ECON_DEBT_0002.reason: Equivalence criteria are now explicit, but recovery behavior and perturbation classes still require qualification.

ECON_DEBT_0001.reason: Sigma_D depends on Org_a and does not prove Org_a axioms.

simulation_alignment.interpretation: Simulation outputs may test whether two organizations preserve recovery behavior, but cannot alone establish Sigma_D equivalence.

Move Sigma_D from GAP_OPEN to GAP_EQUIVALENCE_DEFINITION_CANDIDATE

must_state: Sigma_D is a preserved organization-signature, not an object label.
Equivalence must preserve inventory, admissibility, orientation, iff_R relation, and recovery behavior.
Simulation observables may support equivalence testing but are not final proof.

validation_requirements: No projection-domain sameness may be used as equivalence proof.
ECON_DEBT_0002 must not be marked closed until qualification/derivation pass.

recommended_next_patch.goal: Qualify Org_a axioms and Sigma_D equivalence criteria against D(A|B)>epsilon_a and iff_R to determine whether ECON_DEBT_0001 and ECON_DEBT_0002 can move toward closure.
